input.quote: 12.3 Additional Termination Rights by AbbVie. AbbVie may terminate this Agreement in its entirety, or on a country or other jurisdiction -by-country or other jurisdiction basis, for any or no reason, upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to Harpoon.
input.rationale: Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "termination fee" and acceleration language return no results, and Article 12 imposes no payment on AbbVie (our party) for exercising termination. Section 12.3 allows AbbVie to terminate for any or no reason on 90 days' notice with no early-termination or minimum fee; Section 12.10.1 preserves only accrued amounts (milestones/royalties for events occurring before termination), which is ordinary earned consideration rather than a liquidated damages amount. Section 6.10 late-payment interest applies mutually to "either Party" and is compensatory interest, not a penalty. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline is required.
